segs.text: Lust never attacks all at once. It comes in steps.
First, one look you tell yourself is harmless.
Then a second look. Then the scroll.
Then thoughts you cannot switch off at night.
Then you are doing the thing you swore you would never do.
That is why Allah did not only say don't do it. He said: Do not go near adultery. It is truly a shameful deed and an evil way.

quote.text: Do not go near adultery. It is truly a shameful deed and an evil way.

segs.text: Don't fight the last step. Cut the first one.
Lower your gaze. Close the app. Make wudu.
Send this to a brother who is fighting this. Quietly.
